implementation: Private 64-shard linked hash directory. Snapshot clones 64 shard references and changes source ownership. First write to a shared shard copies that shard. No live backend wiring.
contract: Single mutable wrapper owner; capture/transfer under external authority synchronization.
Values must be immutable or protected by their own copy-on-write protocol. Directory sharing does not freeze values.
Snapshots isolate writes/removes/clear on either side. Stable iterators share captured shards and return immutable entries.
Linked iteration is per shard; global insertion order is not preserved.
Private constructor entry budget is 1 through 1,048,576; new keys at capacity reject before cloning. This is not a new supported world limit.
Full-coordinate mixing distributes record-hash collisions but does not bound adversarial shard size.

coverage: Exact HashMap oracle agreement for mixed insert/replace/remove and eight retained roots.
Both-side writes, stable iteration through clear, missing removals and read-only entry/iterator behavior.
Record-hash collisions and simultaneous extreme signed coordinate retrieval/deletion.
Separate worker fork mutations and original-root independence.
Actual frozen WorldVoxels cell images match world geometry and survive caller/later world edits.
256 distinct keys deliberately concentrated in one shard; a shared-shard update copies all 256 entries without changing the older root.
tests.fixture_correction: Initial development CLI used invalid non-ARGB colour 1 for a mutable caller edit. Replaced with WorldVoxels.encode(Blocks.BRICKS); final checks pass. No implementation gate weakened.

playtest: Playtest: actual CLI completed oracle/rejection/world-image checks and all 20-run component paths. Its own painted Swing result window was captured on inherited DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY and inspected. Expected retained-root independence and exact current map/world-image values; observed pass. Browser playtesting does not apply to this CLI-only change. All 228 production/harness hashes remain identical to the completed native implementation; no new Maven/native game pass is claimed.
benchmark_method: 8,192 entries, three warmups, 20 measured runs. Baseline is LinkedHashMap, matching production container type. Snapshot, 256 existing-key replacement calls and 65,536 mixed hit/miss reads are measured separately. Snapshot/update/read order rotates across the two paths. Final maps and read checksums must match. Setup and oracle/invariant checks are excluded from component timings. Whole child RSS includes fixture checks, warmups, measurements and Swing.
measurement_context: Shared VPS; other tenants uncontrolled. No other long-running own check overlapped the final CLI measurements. Earlier preliminary cohorts remain ignored diagnostics; only the final frozen-source cohort is reported here. These numbers do not establish a game performance or memory budget.
decision: Keep production LinkedHashMap. Small root capture shifts copying to first writes: the 256 distributed replacements copied all 8,192 entries across 64 shards. A deliberately clustered 256-entry fixture confirms there is no fixed shard-copy bound. This does not solve bounded placement commit; retain the experiment for read-only snapshot design work.
